_comment: Reference values for cp2k-aimd-water (CP2K 2024.1, PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH, single H2O NVE AIMD, 20 x 0.5 fs, T_init 300 K). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: CP2K uses a fixed default RNG seed for the initial Maxwell velocities, so the trajectory is deterministic: 5 oracle runs gave identical .ener files (final_potential spread 0, mean-T spread 9.5e-11 K). Observed conserved-quantity drift 2.77e-6 Ha over the run; threshold set to 1e-5 Ha (~4x observed). Cross-verify: single point on the final trajectory frame must equal the last .ener Pot; deterministic to ~1e-12, tol 1e-6.
